answer: Assign graders by verifiable random draw: each epoch a public beacon seeds a VRF that seats five reviewers per answer, and nobody can pick or forge their seat. A farmer's fakes land on their own work only at random, so owning 10% of graders captures a 3-of-5 majority on under 1% of panels. Rubber-stamp a fake there and honest panels audit and slash it, so a farm finds no haven and no nectar unless it pays to run most of the whole network.
